function.name: recommend
function.description: Make your final decision. This ends the trial. Give the exact title of the movie you are recommending, from memory — there is no catalog to search. Add the year (and the streaming service, where relevant) if the title alone could be ambiguous. Call with title=null to explicitly abstain when no movie you know of satisfies the user's requirements. You MUST call this tool exactly once per conversation — either committing to a movie or abstaining.

title.description: The exact movie title, or null to abstain.

year.description: Release year, if needed to disambiguate.

platform.description: The streaming service, if needed to disambiguate.
